name: Natalia Mar'alith
summary: Deep in Hive'Regal, Natalia Mar'alith has vanished among the silithid. The night elf priestess and Cenarion Circle researcher entered the wastes of Silithus with her husband, Commander Mar'alith, then went on an expedition into the hives.

sections.title: A Tragic Descent
sections.body: At Cenarion Hold, the Cenarion Circle watches the awakening sands. Natalia joined her husband, Commander Mar'alith, in the wastes, hoping to learn why the silithid were returning and what lay among the ancient Qiraji ruins. She then joined an expedition led by Brann Bronzebeard, the famed explorer, with the dwarven researchers Rutgar Glyphshaper and Frankal Stonebridge.

sections.title: The Crystal of Hive'Regal
sections.body:
The expedition followed strange emanations into the southern reaches of Hive'Regal. Deep in its heart, the companions found a colossal crystal marked with ancient Qiraji glyphs. Natalia leaned close to study the markings, drawn by the crystal's whispering resonance. Dark magic overwhelmed her mind and bound her will to C'Thun.

Her dwarven companions carried Natalia to Cenarion Hold, where druids woke her. Weeks later, she stormed back into their camp, possessed and demanding to return to the hive. They had to fight her off. Now Natalia guards the hive's dread master with zeal.

sections.title: The Commander's Anguish
sections.body: At Cenarion Hold, Commander Mar'alith clings to hope that his wife can be saved. He cannot accept that her mind has been irrevocably shattered. Those who brave Hive'Regal find no captive awaiting rescue. Natalia is a ruthless servant of madness, wielding sacred priest magic warped by the Old God's malice.

faq.answer: Natalia Mar'alith is a night elf priestess of the Cenarion Circle and Commander Mar'alith's wife. She joined Brann Bronzebeard's expedition into Hive'Regal to study the silithid's resurgence, where dark ancient magic overcame her.

faq.q: Where can I find Natalia Mar'alith?
faq.answer: Natalia Mar'alith is deep in Hive'Regal's tunnels in southern Silithus, keeping watch before a glowing crystal covered in glyphs.

faq.q: Why is Natalia hostile to adventurers?
faq.answer: As Natalia studied a Qiraji crystal, the whispers of the Old God C'Thun corrupted her and shattered her mind. She now fiercely defends the crystal from anyone who enters the hive.

faq.q: Who was with Natalia when she went missing?
faq.answer: Natalia entered Hive'Regal with Brann Bronzebeard, Rutgar Glyphshaper, and Frankal Stonebridge. Rutgar and Frankal survived and retreated to the Bronzebeard Encampment in southern Silithus to tell what happened.

faq.q: Why is she so dangerous in combat?
faq.answer: Natalia keeps her formidable priest powers. Her Psychic Scream scatters attackers, and her Greater Heals restore her strength at almost no cost, making her difficult to defeat without constant interruptions.

angles.text: Natalia's fall reminds the kaldorei that even their most dedicated priestesses can fall prey to the ancient horrors beneath Silithus's sands.
At the Bronzebeard Encampment, Rutgar Glyphshaper and Frankal Stonebridge share grim details of Natalia's fall with Alliance explorers retracing Brann's expedition.
